title: Crew Protocol common definitions
description: Shared definitions and the envelope every Crew object carries.

hash.description: A content address: sha256 of the canonical object without its id.

opaque_id.description: An id assigned by the core (crew, run, check). Opaque to members.

member_id.description: A crew member. The words lead, all, core and person are reserved.

token.description: A lowercase identifier such as an engine id, a lane or a code.

commit.description: A full git object id, SHA-1 or SHA-256, in lowercase hex.

rel_path.description: A repository-relative path with forward slashes: no leading slash, no drive, no empty or dot-dot segment.

path_pattern.description: A rel_path, optionally ending in /** to cover a directory tree. v0 has no other glob syntax.

loopback_url.description: An http URL on a loopback address. Probes never leave the machine.

author.description: Who wrote the object. Always stamped by the core, never supplied by a member.

envelope.description: The fields every object carries. A member's draft carries none of them.
